desc: the former "Hospital de Clínicas" on Av. Córdoba e/ Uriburu and Junín, BA. After years of being abandoned, it was demolished in 1975. The "Plaza Dr. Bernardo Houssay" was built on the site. Another Hospital de Clínicas (named "José de San Martín") was built just one block from there, on Av. Córdoba 2351, being opened in 1962.
